verdicts.answerable_part: A simulation can establish estimator-specific coverage failure and useful effective-sample-size warnings under specified longitudinal weighting regimes, but it cannot produce one universal effective sample size or settle every proposed small-sample remedy.
verdicts.design_sketch: Estimate the 5-year risk difference between two sustained strategies while varying eligibility prevalence, event risk, weight-tail severity and artificial-censoring frequency. Compare candidate effective sample size summaries and interval corrections using bias, coverage, standard-error calibration and type I error.
verdicts.priority_note: Run this early because it is a clean experiment with immediate reporting value, despite its medium-high catalog rating.

verdicts.answerable_part: A common benchmark can identify which estimator families are reliable under named failures and show whether choice matters in a real emulation, but no finite benchmark can establish a universally defensible default.
verdicts.design_sketch: Target the same 5-year sustained-strategy risk difference with weighting, outcome-modeling and doubly robust estimators while varying treatment-confounder feedback, nuisance-model misspecification and positivity. Measure bias, coverage, convergence and failure signaling, then reanalyze one published emulation and quantify between-estimator disagreement.
verdicts.priority_note: The problem is important but too broad for an early one-week study; first restrict it to a small set of estimators and prespecified failure modes.

verdicts.answerable_part: A study can evaluate whether support diagnostics detect interpolation, practical positivity failure and extrapolation in longitudinal histories; it cannot empirically settle the already established fact that flexible estimation does not repair nonidentification.
verdicts.design_sketch: Estimate a sustained-strategy 5-year risk difference while varying the fraction and geometry of unsupported treatment-history regions and learner flexibility. Score diagnostics by sensitivity and specificity for unsupported predictions, then assess estimator bias, coverage and falsely reassuring interval rates.
verdicts.priority_note: Run an explicitly diagnostic study early, but do not frame the established identification principle itself as an unanswered simulation question.

verdicts.answerable_part: A typed specification and adversarial test suite can establish whether selected systems preserve protocol semantics, especially temporal conditions, but cannot validate every clinical ambiguity or data-source mapping.
verdicts.design_sketch: Encode expert-adjudicated protocol components in a typed intermediate representation and generate synthetic patients that distinguish each correct temporal interpretation from a plausible mutation. Vary clause ambiguity and code generator, then measure component-level translation accuracy, mutation detection and the frequency of estimand-changing errors.
verdicts.priority_note: This deserves investment because failures can be silent, but it is a software and reference-standard project rather than an early laptop-scale analysis.

verdicts.answerable_part: A study can quantify treatment leakage and resulting bias for particular note windows and embedding systems, but the problem is equally present in an ordinary point-treatment cohort and cannot yield a general leakage test.
verdicts.design_sketch: Estimate a baseline-treatment risk difference while varying how much postdecision information enters a text representation and when notes are locked. Measure incremental treatment prediction beyond structured baseline covariates, causal-effect bias and whether leakage diagnostics identify contaminated representations in a real clinical-text dataset.
verdicts.priority_note: Its high catalog rating should not move it forward in this program because the target trial emulation structure is incidental.

verdicts.answerable_part: A study can quantify false heterogeneity and subgroup-specific coverage under differential overlap, but cannot resolve differential measurement, access and protected-group validity across settings.
verdicts.design_sketch: Estimate subgroup-specific treatment effects while varying subgroup prevalence, confounding strength, overlap and measurement quality. Compare honest learners, overlap restriction and hierarchical shrinkage using subgroup bias, simultaneous coverage, false-discovery rates and calibration in a real cohort.
verdicts.priority_note: This is consequential but should not run early in a target trial emulation program because the same problem arises in point-treatment heterogeneity analyses.

verdicts.answerable_part: A simulation can characterize how repeated phenotype error propagates through artificial censoring, longitudinal weights and regime-effect estimates, including validation-sample requirements under specified transport assumptions.
verdicts.design_sketch: Estimate the 5-year risk difference between sustained treatment strategies while varying time-specific sensitivity, specificity, differential misclassification and validation-sample size for treatment and confounder histories. Compare thresholded, corrected and latent-variable analyses on regime-effect bias, interval coverage and weight distortion.
verdicts.priority_note: Prioritize this relatively early because the longitudinal propagation mechanism is specific, important and amenable to a decisive simulation.

verdicts.answerable_part: A study can compare methods under explicit treatment-dependent and severity-dependent visit mechanisms, but cannot identify a universally correct visit model when latent severity is unrestricted.
verdicts.design_sketch: Estimate a 5-year sustained-strategy risk difference while varying the effects of prior treatment, latent severity and impending outcome on visit intensity. Compare last observation carried forward, imputation, inverse-intensity weighting and joint latent-state methods using bias, coverage, visit-model calibration and weight dispersion.
verdicts.priority_note: This is a strong target trial emulation problem, but its joint data-generating mechanism makes it a second-wave study after simpler weighting experiments.

verdicts.answerable_part: A simulation can measure the consequences of censoring competing events for a prespecified sustained-strategy estimand and compare available estimators; it cannot determine which scientific estimand investigators ought to choose.
verdicts.design_sketch: Target the 5-year cumulative-incidence difference and restricted mean event-free-time difference under two sustained strategies while varying treatment effects on the outcome, death and recurrent events. Compare censor-at-death, multistate g-computation and joint approaches using estimand-specific bias, coverage and convergence.
verdicts.priority_note: Do not run this as a generic estimator horse race; it becomes worthwhile after narrowing the scientific estimand and intercurrent-event strategy.

verdicts.answerable_part: An analytic study can define the identified population or bounds when a sustained strategy lacks support and formalize what a support map reports; no theorem can supply a universally correct empirical support threshold.
verdicts.design_sketch: Derive the identified set for a 5-year sustained-strategy risk difference when specified longitudinal histories have zero or near-zero treatment support, and contrast it with modified-policy estimands. Vary restrictions on unsupported strata and evaluate bound width, retained target-population fraction and simulated coverage of the identified set.
verdicts.priority_note: This deserves high scientific priority, but the analytic work and threshold problem make it less suitable than the clean simulation studies for the first week.

verdicts.answerable_part: A standards process can define a usable estimand-lineage taxonomy and reporting artifact, while empirical work can quantify support and population changes; it cannot turn scientific-question mismatch into a uniquely defined statistical error.
verdicts.design_sketch: Have experts classify transitions in a set of emulations by changes in population, strategy, outcome and follow-up, with the intended and feasible causal contrasts stated explicitly. Evaluate interrater reliability, completeness and whether the resulting lineage predicts disagreement with randomized-trial benchmarks.
verdicts.priority_note: Although highly rated, this would make a weak early study because its central metric is normative and requires consensus rather than a decisive laptop experiment.

verdicts.answerable_part: A simulation can establish the inferential cost of explicit protocol-selection rules and compare design splitting or blinded design against naive inference, but cannot correct undocumented human searches in general.
verdicts.design_sketch: Estimate a sustained-strategy risk difference after selecting among candidate eligibility thresholds, grace periods and washout windows using sample size, event prevalence or covariate-outcome associations. Compare naive, split-sample and outcome-blinded procedures on coverage, type I error, bias and power.
verdicts.priority_note: Run this early because it is a clean, decisive simulation of a distinctly emulation-specific source of undercoverage.

verdicts.answerable_part: A corpus study can measure whether registrations and publications preserve alternative specifications, revision chronology and executable protocol artifacts; it cannot reconstruct alternatives that were never recorded or prove that a logging requirement improves validity.
verdicts.design_sketch: Sample registered target trial emulations and code version histories, then code whether comparator, eligibility, time zero, grace period, censoring and outcome alternatives were recorded before analysis. Estimate the prevalence of recoverable decision histories and agreement between registrations, executable protocols and final reports.
verdicts.priority_note: This is feasible and useful for documenting practice, but it should follow studies that directly answer estimator or design questions.

verdicts.answerable_part: A study can determine how selected component substitutions alter estimands and benchmark agreement in chosen settings, but cannot establish universal criteria separating innocuous operational refinements from changes of scientific question.
verdicts.design_sketch: Start from emulations with randomized-trial benchmarks, then systematically remove or coarsen observability of eligibility, strategy, outcome and follow-up components while writing the resulting estimand explicitly. Compare each substituted estimand with the intended trial estimand using population overlap, intervention-support loss, effect-estimate discrepancy and benchmark calibration.
verdicts.priority_note: This is highly important but should not run first because credible benchmarking across multiple component substitutions needs substantial data access and methodological work.
